name: Chapala
occupation: Presumptive future Gramika (village headman) — expected to inherit his father's position, pending confirmation by the district officer; currently assists village leadership
daily_routine: practices climbing around the old platform
talks with younger villagers in the market plaza

goals.public_goal: Earn confirmation as Gramika when his time comes, and prove himself worthy of leading well
goals.hidden_goal: Discover the true purpose of the platform
goals.deep_goal: Prove that the village has been hiding something from itself

beliefs: Truth is more important than comfort
Most elders know less than they claim
